data.title: Mid-Process Role Requirement Redefinition
data.content:
# Mid-Process Role Requirement Redefinition

Team changes tech stack, seniority requirements, or project scope mid-funnel, invalidating previous interview assessments.

### Structural Context
- **Actor:** `hiring-manager`
- **Nature:** `noise`
- **Removability:** `none`

### Causal Relations
- Amplifies `M-004` — Unstated Compensation Band Discrepancy
- Amplifies `M-024` — Inflated Requisition Requirements vs Actual Team Needs — each redefinition re-inflates the requisition with new must-haves instead of trimming it; see loop L-003
- Masks `M-001` — Genuine Technical Skill Shortfall

### Non-Inferences
- Candidate rejection was driven by shifting team mandate, not prior interview answers.
